source.generator: app/lib/convex-seed/build-seed.ts buildBorrowSeed() with default options, plus app/lib/borrow-sim.ts, app/lib/data/catalog/lend and app/lib/prices/price-fixture.ts
source.note: Values a fresh seed writes to the sandbox Convex (fixed SANDBOX_NOW clock). The live sandbox deployment drifts from them through user activity (shared liquidity ledger, daily rollups) and live token prices. latestDay is the seed's last daily row per market.

proposedMappingNotes: Every proposedOnchain field is a proposal for the stack session and Josue, not a decision. The sandbox has no Hubs and runs every market on one chain (chainId 1, shown as Testnet); Hub, chain and integration per Spoke are inferred from the Spoke's pairs and venue.

support=native: the venue has an Avana integration (Uniswap v3 or Slipstream). support=emulated-venue: Avana has no integration for the venue (Uniswap v2, Curve, Balancer, Aerodrome basic pools); a concentrated-liquidity position would stand in under the sandbox's names and labels. support=emulated-stock-tokens: also needs local test tokens for the tokenized stocks.
The anvil deploy config lists GHO and USDC as debt assets. The sandbox's other borrowable symbols (see summary.debtReserveSymbols) need debt reserves on the Hubs.
Lend assets ETH and BTC are native-asset labels in the sandbox; on chain they would be wrapped tokens or local test tokens with those symbols.
